text:
tanya_kov: Heads-up 9StellarMed wants an air-gapped POC delivered by courier (sealed crate). Their asks: incremental-only updates (no full-image push), signed manifests, tamper-evident chain-of-custody (QR + custody log), and a procurement-approved upgrade cadence they can lock into contract. Also asked for a multi-year per-site support price and sample indemnity language for physical delivery.

mike_olson: We can support chunked delta bundles + signed manifests. Important constraints to highlight: some large quantized model shards don't delta well -> fallback to full shard swap. Agent version requirement for delta apply: >=2.8.1. For chain-of-custody we can produce a custody.log and manifest.sig stored on the media.

chloe_yu: Ops notes / delivery options:
- delivery modes: encrypted sealed SSD crate with tamper-evident seal and QR, signed ISO on USB, or encrypted tarball on encrypted external drive.
- apply command for on-site operator: `redwood-offline-apply --manifest /mnt/drive/manifest.json --verify --custody /mnt/drive/custody.log`
- we provide sha256 checksums and a custody log that includes packer, timestamp, signer, and courier id.

eng-sales-bot: POC ticket created: POC-33821 assigned to mike_olson. Link: https://app.redwood/POC-33821

mike_olson: Cadence recommendation: baseline = bi-annual deltas included. Quarterly cadence available as premium. Monthly cadence or continuous monthly delta = high cost due to packaging ops. Emergency hotfixes (24-72h depending on logistics) available as SLA addon. Note: customer must approve scheduled windows; we cannot push offline applies without signed acceptance.

chloe_yu: Sample manifest (demo; trimmed) well use on the kickoff call:
```
{
  "manifest_version": "1.0",
  "site":"stellarmed-eu-1",
  "bundles":["runtime-4.3.zst","models/clinical-gptq-v2"],
  "delta":true,
  "custody":"custody.log",
  "sig":"MEUCIQ..."
}
```

privacy_ari: Pre-SOW privacy/security checklist we need back from the customer: SBOM acceptance (cyclonedx preferred), root CA exchange method, whether they allow telemetry hashes-only (no payload telemetry), KMS/HSM requirements for signing, and data-retention window for diagnostics. Also need clarity on indemnity limits for physical courier losses. I can draft the questionnaire.

tanya_kov: Pricing guidance for sales: baseline sealed-offline package = $20k/yr/site (packaging, tamper-evident SSD, signed manifests, one bi-annual delta). Quarterly cadence = +$6k/yr/site. Monthly cadence = +$14k/yr/site. Emergency 24h hotfix SLA = +$8k/yr/site or per-event fee. Multi-year discount: 2-year commit = 10% off annual pricing, 3-year commit = 18% off. Physical courier & notarization billed separately T&M.

mike_olson: Rollback policy: we ship previous-manifest bundle archive on the media for rollback; on-site operator runs `redwood-offline-apply --manifest previous-manifest.json --verify --rollback` and we provide a one-click rollback playbook in the crate. We record apply+rollback events in custody.log.

chloe_yu: Logistics note: for tight timelines we can pre-stage monthly deltas in a secure staging bucket and schedule a courier drop with checksums; this reduces packaging time but still requires physical handoff and site acceptance.

privacy_ari: Legal note: we need a signed acceptance of the SBOM and an agreed cap on liability for physical media in the SOW. I'll draft an indemnity appendix and the questionnaire draft.

tanya_kov: Plan: 30m kickoff Fri 9am CET. Agenda: show sealed-demo crate photos & custody log, demo `redwood-offline-apply` verify+rollback on an offline VM, discuss cadence options + multi-year pricing, and review privacy/security questionnaire. Can everyone make it?

mike_olson: I'll prepare a sealed demo bundle, custody.log example, and the rollback playbook. ETA: Thu EOD.

chloe_yu: I'll make the "bring your own media" README and upload checksums to staging.

privacy_ari: I'll attach the questionnaire and indemnity appendix before the call. If StellarMed can share their root cert and courier constraints ahead of time we can simulate full end-to-end in the demo. :thumbsup:
